_note: Routing rules the SAP approver matrix does not carry (R41-R43, R47, R58). The matrix is the MINIMUM chain; these add to it. Everything here is editable in Admin > Org rules — it is configuration, not code. Sources are the 2026-09-03 session with Aiden-Mulqueeny Crilly.

rules.note: Every IT AFE is prepared or reviewed by the coordinator before it is sent. "Any AFE request cannot go without Aiden." (transcript 29:53)
The cost-centre owner wants his associate director to sign first; printed in the form's Project Approvals rows and signed at DocuSign order 1. (transcript 26:43-28:13; screenshots 20:32, 21:40)

IT routes every AFE to Erik regardless of band, because he wants to review them all. He already holds A3/A5 on the IT cost centres, so below $100,001 this rule adds him. May be withdrawn once Finance agrees. (transcript 24:13-25:47)

Fixed Assets receives the completed envelope on every AFE, so the signed set arrives without being asked for (R58). `handoff` also makes this the mailbox the tool writes to once every signature is in: one mail, a standard subject, the requester in copy, for the FA team's own workflow to trigger on.

Above $1M a capital project takes a technical accounting review outside the SAP matrix, by EITHER of these two. Asked for by Imogen and confirmed by Judithmelanie and Lyndsay in Meeting #5 (transcript 27:29-28:44): "if it is more than 1 million, it should go for VP... technical accounting review". The two names were heard on a call recording until 2026-09-21 and were seeded as "Juan Gandhi" and "Janine" - one mis-heard, one a given name with no surname - so the tool refused to guess a mailbox and blocked Send above $1M, which is what it should have done. Shashank confirmed them as Janine Barad and Gabriella Rafter. The mailboxes are still blank on purpose: the directory guesses First_Last@example.com and a coordinator confirms it before anything is sent (R60). Acme's own policy words it as labour rather than total value - "capital projects with $1 million or more in internal and external labor must be approved by the Chief Accounting Officer or designee" - and chainBuilder already tests both the total AND the labour figure against the threshold.

The finance business partner Fixed Assets coordinates with for LSD, rather than the requester - Lyndsay, Meeting #5 (58:33-59:16): "each division has the finance business partner... we used to connect only the finance business partner". Seen raising an AFE on Douglas Grahame's behalf in the hand-back mail of 2026-09-11.

Fixed Assets Supervisor. No internal order is created until Judithmelanie or Jarrod has approved the issue (Lyndsay, 2026-09-18). Either may approve; neither may then key SAP on the same AFE, which is four eyes by identity rather than by role.

Fixed Assets Manager, the second of the two who may approve the issue. Held only the leadership role until 2026-09-20, so the person the business names as an approver could not open a Fixed Assets screen at all.
